description_en: Queries the access configuration provisioning list by calling ListAccessConfigurationProvisionings
description_zh: 调用ListAccessConfigurationProvisionings查询访问配置部署列表
name: ListAccessConfigurationProvisionings

parameters.help_en: The access configuration ID used as a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 访问配置ID，用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The task target type used as a filter condition for the query.

Valid values: RD-Account, which indicates that the task target type is an account in a resource directory.

TargetId and TargetType must both be specified to form a valid filter condition
parameters.help_zh:
任务目标类型，用于查询的过滤条件。

取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号。

`TargetId`与`TargetType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The task target ID used as a filter condition for the query.

TargetId and TargetType must both be specified to form a valid filter condition
parameters.help_zh:
任务目标ID，用于查询的过滤条件。

`TargetId`与`TargetType`必须同时配置才能作为有效的过滤条件进行查询
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The provisioning status used as a filter condition for the query. Valid values:

Provisioned: The access configuration is provisioned.
ReprovisionRequired: The access configuration needs to be re-provisioned.
DeprovisionFailed: The provisioning failed
parameters.help_zh:
部署状态，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

Provisioned：部署成功。
ReprovisionRequired：需要重新部署。
DeprovisionFailed：部署失败
parameters.name: provisioning_status

parameters.help_en:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify NextToken for the first request.

If the total number of entries returned for the first request exceeds the value of MaxResults, the entries are truncated. Only MaxResults entries are returned, IsTruncated is set to true, and a NextToken value is returned. Use the NextToken value from the previous response to continue calling the API with the other request parameters unchanged to retrieve the truncated entries. Repeat this operation until IsTruncated is false, which indicates that all entries have been retrieved
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。首次调用API不需要`NextToken`。

当您首次调用API时，如果返回数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，数据会被截断，只返回`MaxResults`条数据，同时，返回参数`IsTruncated`为`true`，返回一个`NextToken`。您可以使用上一次返回的`NextToken`继续调用API，其他请求参数保持不变，查询被截断的数据。您可以按此方法多次查询，直到`IsTruncated`为`false`，表示全部数据查询完毕
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 20.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~20。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the access configuration was first successfully provisioned
CreateTime.description_zh: 首次部署成功的时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

RAMPolicyNames.description_en: The names of the custom policies created in the account in a resource directory
RAMPolicyNames.description_zh: 在RD账号中创建的自定义策略名称

items.description_en:
The name of a custom policy created in the account in a resource directory.

This parameter is returned only when the access configuration has built-in policies
items.description_zh:
在RD账号中创建的自定义策略名称。

只有访问配置存在内置策略，才显示该参数

RAMRoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM role created in the account in a resource directory
RAMRoleName.description_zh: 在RD账号中创建的RAM角色名称

SAMLProviderName.description_en: The name of the SAML IdP created in the account in a resource directory
SAMLProviderName.description_zh: 在RD账号中创建的SAML身份提供商名称

Status.description_en:
The provisioning status. Valid values:

Provisioned: The access configuration is provisioned.
ReprovisionRequired: The access configuration needs to be re-provisioned.
DeprovisionFailed: The provisioning failed
Status.description_zh:
部署状态。取值：

Provisioned：部署成功。
ReprovisionRequired：需要重新部署。
DeprovisionFailed：部署失败

TargetId.description_en:
The task target ID.

When the task target type is `RD-Account`, this parameter is the UID of the account in a resource directory
TargetId.description_zh:
任务目标ID。

当任务目标类型为`RD-Account`时，该参数为RD账号UID

TargetPath.description_en: The path ID of the task target in the resource directory
TargetPath.description_zh: 任务目标在资源目录中的路径ID

TargetPathName.description_en: The path name of the task target in the resource directory
TargetPathName.description_zh: 任务目标在资源目录中的路径名称

TargetType.description_en:
The task target type.

Valid values: RD-Account, which indicates that the task target type is an account in a resource directory
TargetType.description_zh:
任务目标类型。

取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the access configuration was most recently provisioned successfully
UpdateTime.description_zh: 最近一次部署成功的时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the results are truncated. Valid values:

true: The results are truncated.
false: The results are not truncated
IsTruncated.description_zh:
返回结果是否被截断。取值：

true：已截断。
false：未截断

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results.

This parameter is returned only when IsTruncated is true
NextToken.description_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。

只有`IsTruncated`为`true`，才显示该参数

TotalCounts.description_en: The total number of entries that match the request parameters
TotalCounts.description_zh: 符合请求参数条件的数据总条数
